title: Would you use a platform like this?
author: Any-Method4476
selftext:
Hey! Me and two colleagues who also trade Forex have been working on this for the past year. Basically, we got tired of spending weeks or even months building bots for strategies that sometimes ended up not being worth it.  
  
I’m the only one with a software engineering background, and with a full-time job on the side, even with the help of AI nowadays, it could still take me months to get a bot running live without issues and to a point where we’d actually trust it with our own accounts.  
  
So we started building something where all of us, not just me, could create, backtest, and deploy strategies live much faster and more easily (check the demo). That’s how [Nodlow.ai](http://Nodlow.ai) started.  
  
It’s still in beta and we’ve tested it a lot ourselves, but I’d love to get more people playing with it and finding the stuff we missed. If you hit any limits, just message us with the support chat in the app and we’ll happily upgrade your limits.
